youtube.title: Why The F And J Keys Have Bumps ⌨️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Look at your keyboard. Two keys have tiny bumps on them, and there's a reason.

The bumps on F and J mark where your index fingers rest on the home row, so touch typists can find their place by feel without looking. Number pads and phone keypads put a bump on the 5 for the same reason.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
